APPROVE
Pulling the per-job grant check and the inherited-grant check into helpers takes out about 14 points of nested control flow, which leaves `UnusedWriteScopeGrants` at roughly 11. The helpers keep the same early exits (`continue` became `return`), fill `inheriting` in the same order, emit grants in the same order, and the braces balance; this is from reading the diff only, because the repository isn't on this machine and I couldn't compile it or check that the helper signatures (`body`'s type, `static`) match the surrounding code.
